stories.title: Eurovision Song Contest Asia
stories.summary: The Philippines, with the song "Sobra-Sobra" by Carmelle, wins the inaugural Eurovision Song Contest Asia held in Bangkok, Thailand.
stories.about: The Eurovision Song Contest Asia (ESCA) is an international song competition modelled after the Eurovision Song Contest, where broadcasters from the Asia-Pacific region compete representing their countries. The inaugural edition, organised by Voxovation under licence from the European Broadcasting Union (EBU), produced by S2O Productions, and staged by host broadcaster Channel 3, was held on 14 November 2026 at One Bangkok Forum in Bangkok, Thailand, with broadcasters from eleven countries taking part.
